assertions.name: A6_orderings_right_magnitudes_not
assertions.source: n heavier than p and 3H heavier than 3He; model n/p 1.6069 against 1.00137841917

description: Locates the weak channel. The simplest low-mass systems are the free neutron (A=1) and tritium 3H -> 3He (A=3, Q = 18.59 keV, the lowest-Q beta decay in nature), whose endpoints are the mirror pair this series already computes. Formally beta decay is d -> u, which under the flavour rule changes the beta ASSIGNMENT — neutron udd (1/2,1/2,1) to proton uud (0,1/2,1/2) — and involves no generator at all, which is why none of the three per-nucleon slots (3k intra, 3k+1 EM, 3k+2 strong) is free for weak: it does not need one. The unique W with v_n . W = v_p exists (det 1.067, residual 1.15e-41), is not a crossing (nearest template at distance 0.99, identity coefficient 0.9892), and has a STRUCTURAL ZERO in its sigma_0 coefficient — the strong-channel generator — in the n -> p direction only (1.2e-32, -5.2e-53, 1.3e-82 at 30, 50, 80 dps), while p -> n holds a stable -0.00225962 there. n -> p is the direction that happens spontaneously. 20.0% of W's block weight sits in the alt block that convention D annihilates, so a fifth of it is invisible to the 0th-order trace — but less than the nucleons themselves carry (30.8% and 37.9%), so this is not 'weak lives in the radical'. Both mass orderings come out right (neutron heavier than proton, 3H heavier than 3He) and both magnitudes wrong by orders.
caveats: THE DIRECTIONAL ZERO IS AN OBSERVATION, NOT A MECHANISM. That W(n->p) has no sigma_0 component while W(p->n) does, and that n -> p is the spontaneous direction, is a genuine structural asymmetry — but nothing here derives beta decay from it, predicts a rate or a lifetime, or shows the zero is what makes one direction preferred. Establishing any of that would need a dynamical principle the construction does not currently have.

'W' IS THE ALGEBRAIC CONNECTOR, NOT A WEAK INTERACTION OPERATOR. It is defined purely by v_n . W = v_p, i.e. as whatever element carries one nucleon word to the other. Calling it the weak transition operator is an interpretation. In particular it carries no lepton content: the emitted electron and antineutrino appear nowhere, and the construction has no strand or generator for a neutrino at all.

The magnitudes are wrong by orders, as everywhere in this series. The model's n/p mass ratio is 1.607 against a physical 1.00138, and its 3H-3He splitting is 14.5% of the scale against a physical Q/M of 6.6e-6. Only the two ORDERINGS are being claimed, and they are claimed as signs rather than scales precisely because no mass normalisation has been applied.
